INPUT A (M x N), B (N x P)

C <- CALL create_matrix(LENGTH OF A, LENGTH OF B[0], NONE)

FOR i from 0 to LENGTH OF A-1:
    FOR j from 0 to LENGTH OF B[0]-1:
        sum <- 0

        FOR k from 0 to LENGTH OF B-1:
            sum <- sum + A[i][k] * B[k][j]

        C[i][j] = sum

RETURN C
